name: indian tofu fritters
instructions:
The INDIAN version of the crispy-tofu fritter plate — third member of the family after [[tofu-calamari]] (european/tapas) and [[mexican-tofu-fritters]] (mexican).

=== THE TOFU (THE FAMILY CHASSIS, INDIAN COAT) ===

- SUPER FIRM / EXTRA FIRM tofu (no pressing — the family rule; firm tofu clashing), HAND-SHREDDED for fractal edges.
- The coat: CORNSTARCH, SALT, CURRY POWDER, KASHMIRI CHILI POWDER, and MASA HARINA (tastes better than chickpea flour).
- Toss in oil, bake at ~425°F until crisp and browned (the calamari chassis).
- AMCHUR MANGO POWDER dusted AFTER baking (not baked) — a great addition; see the sourness note.

=== THE SPREAD ===

- CHUTNEYS: good with chutneys ([[jam-chutney]]; [[mint-cilantro-yogurt]] is the same shelf).
- Also good with TIKKA MASALA SAUCE ([[tikka-masala]]).
notes:
=== THE CONCEPT — THE FRITTER CHASSIS GONE INDIAN (2026-11-20) ===

Same crispy-tofu engine as [[tofu-calamari]] and [[mexican-tofu-fritters]] (no-press tofu, hand-shredded, starch coat, hot oven), moved to the indian register: curry powder + kashmiri chili powder in the coat.

=== MASA HARINA OVER CHICKPEA FLOUR ===

MASA HARINA tastes better than CHICKPEA FLOUR here — the masa stays in the coat even though chickpea flour would be the 'indian' choice (pakora logic).

=== AMCHUR (2026-11-20) — DUSTED AFTER, NOT BAKED ===

AMCHUR MANGO POWDER is a great addition to the fritters — DUSTED AFTER baking, not baked — unless your sauce is already sour (amchur in the tikka sauce, or vinegar). And even if so, still pretty good.

=== THE SAUCE SHELF ===

Good with CHUTNEYS, but also TIKKA MASALA SAUCE ([[tikka-masala]]).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[tofu-calamari]]: the european original — same tofu rules (super/extra firm no-press, firm tofu clashing), tapas condiments.
- [[mexican-tofu-fritters]]: the mexican sibling — cornmeal/masa + new mexican/guajillo coat, salsa shelf.
- [[tikka-masala]]: the sauce these are good with.
- [[jam-chutney]] / [[mint-cilantro-yogurt]]: the chutney shelf.
original_chef: Mine — the tofu-calamari structure moved to the indian register.
